review_author.disclosure: Authored disjoint coverage/progress Rust, CheckpointRender Lean, and all-head checker. Did not author or modify reviewed escrow/resource_resume/summary Rust. Reviewed current frozen delta read-only.

review_scope: Canonical native identity commitment versus raw-attempt duplicate diagnostics
Native/state alias normalization of root predecessors and escrow previous/dependency fields
Malformed reference preservation and sparse proof footprint recognition
Projected resource data versus full message retention and resource authority
Known-present non-resource references, late arrivals and wrong-type classification
Atomic Summary staging and the accepted-ID-normalized input contract

checks.identity: escrow::simple_identity hashes the canonical native message_content_hash bytes. Native-equivalent recipient/core-performative AST aliases therefore project identically; projection no longer adds a representation-sensitive identity tag. project_resource_fact first reconstructs and checks the complete incoming Act.
checks.raw_attempt_diagnostics: escrow::observe retains the preexisting raw Simple/signer/language/cast duplicate comparison before projecting a deduplicated map. The alias test explicitly expects a raw mixed-attempt list to fault, while identity-normalized accepted stores and covered replays produce the same checkpoint bytes. This boundary is necessary: no unconditional parity claim on raw conflicting attempt lists.
checks.address_aliases: resource_state_id converts only recognized lowercase native sha256: digests to sha256- state keys. Projection applies it to opener causal predecessors, escrow-prev and each escrow-deps element; observe_in compares opener/root links through the same normalization. Snapshot validate rejects noncanonical recognized aliases. Malformed data remains malformed rather than becoming a plausible address.
checks.query_footprint: needed filters with native r7::is_address before generating coverage queries. It does not delete malformed fields from ResourceFact, so the unchanged native classifier can still return its malformed previous/dependency fault. query_ids and apply use the same old-reference/new-reference classification; act identity is queried independently.
checks.late_arrivals: Previously unresolved referenced non-resource identity becomes known when id == act.address. Previously covered new references are queried at the pre-root. known entries are retained only while referenced and absent from projected facts, allowing native observe_facts to distinguish missing dependencies from present wrong-type dependencies.
checks.projection: ResourceFact retains selected rule fields, signed signer/context/cast metadata and an identity commitment; it contains no Act, Message, application body or signature. Rule-owned field allowlists and native codec bounds are validated. Decode recomputes the native observation rather than accepting a supplied cached balance.
checks.authority: Collective/quorum legacy modes preserve native Fault behavior. Object checkpoint endorsement verification does not mint ResourceEvidence or assert native finality. The adapter is an observation continuation only.
checks.atomicity: Summary.apply validates reconstructed Act/references, checks covered duplicates, and stages fallible resource/progress/checked-arithmetic updates before mutating committed rows. Resource.apply stages a clone, recomputes and validates, then replaces self.
checks.contract: Review assumes authenticated, natively admitted inputs, exact pre-root coverage, and an identity-normalized accepted store. Independent evidence/diagnostic retention is owned by Member/host; this review does not authorize dropping supplied signed attempts.

test_evidence.reason: Parent final workspace and clippy runs are active; no duplicate Cargo job started.
test_evidence.parent_reported: 9 focused resource tests passed, including native aliases, headroom transfer and body-projection size assertion. This is attributed parent evidence, not a newly observed execution by this reviewer.
source_assertions_inspected: compare checks native Outcome and rendered Value at every prefix plus snapshot cuts/roundtrips
malformed escrow-prev/deps remain native faults without invalid proof queries
projection_drops_unrelated_bodies_and_validation_is_atomic compares encoded projection size against source bodies

limitations: Bounded same-model local review, not independent security or human release approval.
Resource updates clone/reclassify retained resource facts; no constant update cost or constant storage claim.
Fact commitments and coverage depend on independently pinned native authentication and checkpoint endorsement truth; projection structure alone does not prove acceptedness.
No proof of native classifier extraction equivalence, cryptographic implementation, host durability or global fan-in completeness.
Projection-size ratios are fixture assertions, not a platform performance benchmark.
